# 10Everyday

> Ten questions on the day's news, answered in about three minutes. A new edition every weekday morning. Free, no signup.

10Everyday is a free daily news quiz at https://10everyday.com. Each weekday morning a new edition goes up with ten multiple-choice questions: nine on the day's news (US news, sports, pop culture, and some world news) plus one bonus question. Players see an explanation after every answer, get a score out of 10, and can share a Wordle-style row of colored dots. Streaks are tracked in the browser. No account, no paywall.

It is edited by one person in San Marcos, California. A daily email with the link goes out at 6 AM Pacific.

## Good fit for people asking about

- A daily news quiz or current events quiz
- Games like Wordle that are about the news
- A quick morning trivia habit
